test_title: PYST 37: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A fort had provision for 400 men for 60 days. After 35 days, 100 more men came. For how many days would the provisions last, assuming all men consumed food equally?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining days for original men = 60 − 35 = 25 days.

Total remaining provision = 400 men × 25 days.

New total men after arrival = 400 + 100 = 500 men.

Days the provision will last = (400 × 25) ÷ 500 = 20 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of men (M₁) = 400

Total provision duration = 60 days

Days passed before new men arrived = 35 days

Number of new men joined = 100

**Formula Used:**

M₁ × D₁ = M₂
